The 2026 Triumph Bonneville T40 brings classic Bonneville styling to the 350cc segment, but how does it ride? We take it out for a first ride to find out.
Priced at ₹2.8 lakh (ex-showroom), the Bonneville T40 gets a 349cc TR-series single-cylinder engine with a revised camshaft, airbox and engine tune. It retains the classic Bonneville design, with a teardrop fuel tank, twin shocks, spoke wheels and a peashooter exhaust.
It also gets modern features including a colour TFT display, riding modes, cruise control, cornering ABS and traction control.
